fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `batch`.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: The OpenAI API endpoint used by the batch.

fields.name: model
fields.description:
Model ID used to process the batch, like `gpt-5-2025-08-07`. OpenAI
offers a wide range of models with different capabilities, performance
characteristics, and price points. Refer to the [model
guide](/docs/models) to browse and compare available models.

fields.name: inputFileId
fields.description: The ID of the input file for the batch.

fields.name: completionWindow
fields.description: The time frame within which the batch should be processed.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current status of the batch.

fields.name: outputFileId
fields.description: The ID of the file containing the outputs of successfully executed requests.

fields.name: errorFileId
fields.description: The ID of the file containing the outputs of requests with errors.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch was created.

fields.name: inProgressAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch started processing.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch will expire.

fields.name: finalizingAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch started finalizing.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch was completed.

fields.name: failedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch failed.

fields.name: expiredAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch expired.

fields.name: cancellingAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch started cancelling.

fields.name: cancelledAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the batch was cancelled.

fields.name: requestCounts
fields.description: The request counts for different statuses within the batch.

fields.name: usage
fields.description:
Represents token usage details including input tokens, output tokens, a
breakdown of output tokens, and the total tokens used. Only populated on
batches created after September 7, 2025.
